cases.title: Toggle Text Box Visibility
cases.description: Verify that clicking the toggle button (data-testid='toggle-button') successfully shows and hides the text box (data-testid='text-box') by adding and removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Rapid Repeated Clicks on Toggle Button
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the toggle button handle state correctly without inconsistent final visibility of the text box.

cases.title: Close Text Box via Close Button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the close button (data-testid='close-button') inside the visible text box hides the text box by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Close Button Boundary and Toggling
cases.description: Verify that clicking the close button when already hidden or toggling immediately after closing behaves as expected.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Text Box Open
cases.description: Verify that opening the text box invokes getVoices() and populates the voice dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') with available voices and languages.

cases.title: Update Voices on voiceschanged Event
cases.description: Verify that the system listens for the 'voiceschanged' event and dynamically updates the voice dropdown accordingly.

cases.title: Select Voice from Dropdown
cases.description: Verify that selecting a voice from the voice dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') correctly assigns it to message.voice for speech synthesis, including voices with specific language codes like 'CN' or 'US'.

cases.title: Multiple Successive Voice Selections
cases.description: Verify that making multiple successive voice selections correctly sets the last selected voice as the active voice.

cases.title: Read Entered Text Aloud
cases.description: Verify that entering text into the textarea (data-testid='text-area') and clicking the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button') reads the text aloud using the selected voice.

cases.title: Read Text Edge Cases
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when clicking the read button with empty text or when the text box is toggled off.

cases.title: Click Predefined Phrase Box
cases.description: Verify that clicking a predefined phrase box reads the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box with the 'active' class for 800 milliseconds.

cases.title: Sequential and Rapid Phrase Box Clicks
cases.description: Verify that sequential clicks across different boxes and rapid repeated clicks on the same box correctly trigger speech playback and visual feedback.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all requirements comprehensively, including boundary conditions, rapid interactions, and event handling. No blockers were identified.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-1: Normal scenario - Click toggle-button (data-testid='toggle-button') to show text-box (data-testid='text-box') by adding 'show' class; click again to hide it by removing 'show' class. Edge scenario - Rapid repeated clicks on toggle-button. Boundary scenario - Initial state where text-box is hidden. Abnormal scenario - None identified. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-2: Normal scenario - Click toggle-button to make text-box visible, then click close-button (data-testid='close-button') inside text-box to hide it. Edge scenario - Clicking close-button when text-box is already hidden. Boundary scenario - Toggling immediately after closing. Abnormal scenario - None identified. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-3: Normal scenario - Open text-box using toggle-button, triggering getVoices() to populate voice-select (data-testid='voice-select') with option elements showing voice names and languages. Edge scenario - voiceschanged event triggers dynamic dropdown update. Boundary scenario - Selecting a voice immediately after population. Abnormal scenario - Handling empty voice list or unsupported Web Speech API. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-4: Normal scenario - Select a voice from voice-select to assign to message.voice. Edge scenario - Multiple successive voice selections ensuring the last selected voice is active; selecting voices with language codes like 'CN' or 'US'. Boundary scenario - Selecting the default or first voice in the list. Abnormal scenario - Selecting a voice when no voices are loaded. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-5: Normal scenario - Enter text into text-area (data-testid='text-area'), select a voice, and click read-button (data-testid='read-button') to read text aloud. Edge scenario - Clicking read-button with empty text or with text-box toggled off. Boundary scenario - Reading maximum length text input. Abnormal scenario - Web Speech API synthesis failure during read. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-6: Normal scenario - Click a predefined phrase box to read its associated text aloud and add 'active' class for 800ms. Edge scenario - Rapid repeated clicks on the same phrase box or sequential clicks across different boxes. Boundary scenario - Clicking phrase box while previous speech is still active. Abnormal scenario - Missing image or paragraph data in the array.
